episodes.title: I/O
episodes.summary: The Texan company Cardiff Electronics gets a new employee from New York. He's apparently working for IBM, but after the he gets the new job it gets clear that he has a hidden agenda, and is not exactly what he claims to be.

episodes.title: FUD
episodes.summary: Joe's team must overcome internal differences and start building the new machine.

episodes.title: High Plains Hardware
episodes.summary: Despite IBM's raid on Cardiff Electric's clients, Joe has convinced those concerned, most specifically Gordon and Cameron, to continue with the PC project. The company is in a much weakened state because of the raid leading to staff layoffs, which an ill-equipped Gordon is responsible for issuing to the affected engineering staff, and the search for investors for the PC project. Joe and Bosworth have differing views on where those moneys can potentially come from.

episodes.title: Close to the Metal
episodes.summary: With a mid-project success with the BIOS code, Joe makes two bold moves within the office. First, he destroys the book that contains the IBM proprietary code, and second, he invites Wall Street Quarterly to do a story about their PC clone project. The story Joe wants written may not happen first because the reporter, Ron Kane, doesn't see what's happening as being newsworthy, and second as a crisis occurs in the office during Kane's visit, that crisis issue which may in turn be the story.

episodes.title: Adventure
episodes.summary: The Wall Street Quarterly article and Cameron being able to complete the BIOS code have created renewed public interest in the PC project, upon which Joe wants to capitalize, not only for the project but also for himself. Cameron is dismayed however to learn that Joe's suggested vacation for her was so that he could hire a software engineering team behind her back.

episodes.title: Landfall
episodes.summary: Cameron and Gordon clash over their differing plans for the computer's operating system while Joe struggles to connect with his colleagues.

episodes.title: Giant
episodes.summary: The next phase of the PC project is design. Believing it could be aesthetically beautiful and not just another beige box, Joe is able to call in an old friend, top industrial designer Simon Church, to come up with a concept. Simon's arrival onto the scene has the possibility to alienate both Gordon and Cameron, but for different reasons.

episodes.title: The 214s
episodes.summary: Scandal rocks Cardiff Electric as the team finalizes preparations for COMDEX. Bosworth makes a sacrifice for the good of the PC program.

episodes.title: Up Helly Aa
episodes.summary: Unforeseen adversaries and new complications threaten to derail all that the Cardiff Electric team has worked for at COMDEX.
As Gordon and Joe prepare to ship the Giant, a suspicious defect calls their partnership into question. Cameron takes her future into her own hands.

episodes.title: SETI
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 opener, Cameron and Donna's fledgling gaming company, Mutiny, finds itself at a crossroads. Meanwhile, Joe and Gordon are reunited in the wake of Cardiff's sale.

episodes.title: New Coke
episodes.summary: After meeting Sara's father, Joe begins a new job. Meanwhile, Gordon grapples with his new freedom as Donna is blindsided by Cameron's surprising hire at Mutiny.

episodes.title: The Way In
episodes.summary: The Clarks receive a surprising invitation as Bosworth tries to reconnect with his former life. Meanwhile, a problem from within Mutiny threatens its survival.

episodes.title: Play with Friends
episodes.summary: Joe and Gordon reunite to make Joe's vision a reality. Meanwhile, at Mutiny, tensions between Cameron and Donna run high in the aftermath of Sonaris.

episodes.title: Extract and Defend
episodes.summary: Cameron and Joe cross paths again, putting Cameron in a tailspin. Meanwhile, Gordon searches for connection as he processes difficult news.

episodes.title: 10Broad36
episodes.summary: Gordon returns to California to reconnect with his brother, Henry, as Joe uses his newfound leverage to change Wheeler's thinking about computing.

episodes.title: Working for the Clampdown
episodes.summary: Gordon and Donna harbor secrets from one another as Gordon launches a new venture. Meanwhile, at Mutiny, an acquisition puts Cameron's principles to the test.

episodes.title: Limbo
episodes.summary: Cameron and Tom try to come to terms at Mutiny's user picnic. Meanwhile, Gordon searches for answers as Joe and Sara say goodbye to Dallas.

episodes.title: Kali
episodes.summary: Left reeling by the launch of a rival, Mutiny takes measures to ensure its survival. Meanwhile, Gordon pays a price in an attempt to quell his paranoia.

episodes.title: Heaven is a Place
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Gordon aids Joe as the Clark family descends into crisis. Meanwhile, Cameron envisions a new future for Mutiny that may not include everyone.

episodes.title: Valley of the Heart's Delight
episodes.summary: In the third-season premiere, Donna and Cameron explore their options to expand beyond chat. Meanwhile, Gordon settles in at Mutiny; and Joe launches his latest product.

episodes.title: One Way or Another
episodes.summary: While Cameron and Donna struggle to find venture capital, Joe hires a key coder, leaving the rest of the team at a loss.

episodes.title: Flipping the Switch
episodes.summary: Gordon and Donna's personal life bleeds into work, causing tension at the office; Joe meets with the MacMillan board.

episodes.title: Rules of Honorable Play
episodes.summary: A game of laser tag teaches Gordon the importance of teamwork; Donna and Cameron disagree on their acquisition.

episodes.title: Yerba Buena
episodes.summary: Donna and Gordon treat themselves to a vacation at home instead of camping; Joe and Ryan have a revelation; Cameron and Bos return to Texas.

episodes.title: And She Was
episodes.summary: An offer to purchase Mutiny creates tension; Gordon and Cam bond over video games while Donna has a weekend to herself; Joe faces off against the board.

episodes.title: The Threshold
episodes.summary: Joe and Ryan face the consequences of Joe's decision; Gordon experiences a crisis of conscience; Donna and Cameron fight about the future.

episodes.title: You Are Not Safe
episodes.summary: Diane, Bos and Donna hit the road in hopes of building support for Mutiny; everyone else awaits the big day; Joe approaches Cam for a favor.

episodes.title: NIM
episodes.summary: Donna tries to bring everyone together at Comdex with her vision of the internet's future; Gordon faces a strong-willed Joanie.

episodes.title: NeXT
episodes.summary: Donna's vision creates a spirited discussion over the next big thing, and how to achieve it. The end result may not make everyone happy.

episodes.title: So It Goes
episodes.summary: Gordon enjoys success while Joe works to keep their web project afloat; Cameron extends a business trip; Donna launches a new venture.

episodes.title: Signal to Noise
episodes.summary: Joe and Cameron talk on the phone; Donna promotes her assistant; Gordon's business buckles under pressure from a larger competitor.

episodes.title: Miscellaneous
episodes.summary: Cameron promotes her game at an industry conference; Donna squares off against old rivals; Gordon struggles to support Joe's newest idea.

episodes.title: Tonya and Nancy
episodes.summary: Cameron buys a plot of land to recenter; Joe and Gordon hire a team of websurfers to map the web; Donna focuses her team on the mission ahead.

episodes.title: Nowhere Man
episodes.summary: Donna struggles with suspicion; Bosworth hits a breaking point; Joe confesses to Gordon while Cameron faces past mistakes.

episodes.title: A Connection is Made
episodes.summary: Donna makes a play for a heavy-hitter; Gordon confronts his daughter about an issue at school; Cameron finds a new fan; Joe sees a new side of Haley.

episodes.title: Who Needs a Guy
episodes.summary: Joe and Gordon discuss Comet's future; Donna takes a vacation; a new collaborator challenges Cameron; Bos and Diane make a life-altering choice.

episodes.title: Goodwill
episodes.summary: Cameron helps Donna pack up; Bos makes his famous chili; Joe helps Haley recover a memorable keep sake; Gordon and Donna fight.

episodes.title: Search
episodes.summary: Donna faces a professional crossroads; Joanie takes a trip; Joe unveils Comet's new look; Cameron asks a favor from a one-time collaborator.

episodes.title: Ten of Swords
episodes.summary: Donna celebrates a milestone with her closest allies; Cameron contemplates saying goodbye; Joe confronts an uncertain future.
